releaseNotes.headline: Arrange your tools by dragging
releaseNotes.summary: Version 0.2.12 lets you drag AI tools into the order you want in the rail, and keeps each tool’s rings together.

highlights.title: Drag to reorder
highlights.detail: In Manage AI Tools, drag a tool row up or down and release it where you want it. The rail follows that order right away and remembers it.

highlights.title: Tools stay grouped
highlights.detail: A tool’s rings now sit together in the rail, and the up/down buttons reorder limits within that tool.

highlights.title: The rail shows every tool
highlights.detail: The rail grows to fit all of your tools instead of scrolling, up to your display’s height at the current scale.
